Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the final comparison step. The task asked which film has the director born **later** (meaning a higher birth year). The Planner correctly identified the birth years: Gus Van Sant (1952) and Massimo Ceccherini (1965). However, the Planner incorrectly reasoned that because Gus Van Sant was 39 years old at the time of his film's release (1991) and Massimo Ceccherini was 34 at the time of his film's release (1999), the director born later was Gus Van Sant. This logic is flawed because comparing the age at release conflates the release year with the birth year. The correct comparison is simply 1965 > 1952, meaning Massimo Ceccherini was born later. The Planner failed to perform the direct numerical comparison of birth years and instead used an irrelevant metric (age at release) to draw a conclusion that contradicted the ground truth.
